children.value: > Fact From Story: Hamas carried out the biggest coordinated attack in Israel and captured some territory in southern Israel.
> > Fact From Story: It is not the attack that has surprised people but the scale at which Hamas operated and got control of some military bases and soldiers.
> > > Fact From Story: Younis Tirawi, who reports on Palestinian Affairs, said that Hamas militants had taken over Sderot police HQ and armored vehicles in the town.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Seizing a police headquarters is a large operation.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Attacks that seize military bases are large attacks.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A large coordinated attack that captures territory is shocking.
